## Live Flagship Ventures
1. **İtibar (https://itibar.app)**
   - *Category*: LegalTech & B2B Reputation Defense SaaS
   - *Summary*: Automated B2B digital reputation defense, multi-region intelligence pipeline, and legal compliance engine against unfair/fake Google Business reviews.
2. **Unutma. (https://unutma.itibar.app)**
   - *Category*: CivicTech & Physical Communication Infrastructure
   - *Summary*: Digital-to-physical postal automation delivering wax-sealed physical letters and books via PTT Taahhütlü post.

## Selected Shipped Production Lifecycles (Completed Systems)
- **Vera QR & Gideon AI (BMI Law)**: Multi-tenant AI-powered restaurant automation/loyalty SaaS (PostgreSQL RLS, AI Virtual Waiter, Stripe/iyzico) and Dynamic Generative UI enterprise assistant.
- **VoltNet**: Unified real-time geospatial EV charging network platform across iOS, Android, and Web (~40% faster station discovery & checkout).
- **Kürşat (Social Network Platform)**: Full-scale mobile social network built with React Native, Node.js, and MongoDB that reached 5,000+ active users (MAU) in its first month.
- **Lusid AI & İyilik Zinciri**: Privacy-first AI journaling and social motivation mobile applications (4+ weekly active sessions per user).
